title: every Page has a face, even without a photo

criteria.text: The photo step is optional; the composer completes without one
criteria.note: `PagePhotoPicker` sits in the About step of `SellWalkthrough` (`isOptional`) and in `PageEditor`; `photoUrl: null` clears, a failed upload does not trap the member [V src]. Built by #121: no `Reviewed by:` line, label human-review [V]; no deploy-health run for 61902755 [V]. Checked no: unmarked `PagePhotoPicker.test.tsx` ("never blocks the step"), `SellWalkthrough.test.tsx`; zero `[guards F070.n]` markers in src or tests [V grep]. #598.

criteria.text: Stored bytes carry no metadata, GPS included, verified against the file
criteria.note: `upload-image.ts` re-encodes through canvas to WebP; the `media` bucket accepts `image/webp` only (`039_media_bucket.sql`) [V]. Checked no: `upload-image.test.ts:112` reads a GPS fixture byte-level but on pipeline output, not an object read back from the bucket; unmarked [V]. Built by T120 and #121, both before deploy-health ran, and neither carries `Reviewed by:` [V]. #598.

criteria.text: A raw upload that bypasses the client is rejected by the storage API
criteria.note: Bucket `allowed_mime_types` webp, 5MB limit, insert/update/delete scoped to the member's own folder [V migration 039]. `tests/media-bucket-storage-api.test.ts` rejects JPEG, SVG, over 5MB and another member's prefix against a real stack; CI runs the Vitest suite against local Supabase, so it is not skipped there [V ci.yml]. Checked no only because it carries no `[guards F070.3]` marker. #598.

criteria.text: A Page with no photo shows its kind's default image, the same for every viewer; a missing Page picture falls back to it
criteria.note: Built half: `DefaultArt` by kind (shop, service, group) on the Page (`ShopPublicPage`), the browse card (`BrowseResultCard`) and the post card, with the Page-picture-then-placeholder fallback in `PagePosts` (marked F099.6) [V]. Missing: the signed-out withheld card gets no kind, because `announcements_withheld` does not return it and `mapWithheldRow` sets `groupKind: ''`, so `artKindFor` returns null and the tile has no icon; that is not identical for every viewer [V src/lib/feed/withheld-announcements.ts, DefaultArt.tsx]. #335 (open, Beta 11-06). Checked: unmarked `DefaultArt.test.tsx`; #598.

criteria.text: The operator removes a Page's photo in one action
criteria.note: Overtaken by the 2026-09-17 ruling in scenario F058: a moderation decision is a reversible event and removal sets `photo_removed_at` instead of deleting, so one action cannot also delete the bytes. Removal shows in the admin queue as built [V]. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: The photo's stored object is deleted and an event is recorded
criteria.note: Purge is the deliberate second act after removal: `report.purge_target` then `report.purge` delete the object (operator's own session, bucket delete policy `20261007250000_photo_purge.sql`) and write a `photo_purges` row with who, why and the path; a photo held under the F102 child-safety hold is refused [V src/actions/report/purge.ts, docs/purge-proposal.md]. Built by #508 (#491): carries `review-skipped`; deploy-health success on 89bc02ca [V]. Checked no: `purge.test.ts` covers the handlers, unmarked, and nothing deletes a real object. #842.
